overview: TradeNest Naturals manufactures and exports dehydrated red chilli powder for commercial food production. We are an FSSAI-licensed manufacturer and IEC-registered exporter based in India. Our six-step process includes sourcing, cleaning, sorting, controlled drying, grinding, sieving, inspection, and dispatch. The resulting fine-milled powder delivers consistent colour and heat, helping food processors manage recipe uniformity and production efficiency.

We supply wholesale buyers, private label brands, and international importers with flexible order sizes starting from a 5 kg minimum order quantity. The spice features controlled moisture below eight percent and standard mesh grading between 60 and 100 mesh. We offer OEM packaging, custom grinding, samples on request, and full export documentation support for seamless logistics.

faqs.q: What is the minimum order quantity for this product?
faqs.a: The minimum order quantity is 5 Kg for standard bulk orders. We also support larger wholesale consignments and custom OEM packaging runs.

faqs.q: What mesh sizes and moisture levels are available?
faqs.a: Our red chilli powder typically features a 60 to 100 mesh size with moisture levels at or below 8%. Custom mesh specifications are available on request.

faqs.q: Can TradeNest Naturals provide private label packaging?
faqs.a: Yes. We offer comprehensive OEM and private label services, including retail pouches, jars, and customized outer cartons with agreed branding.

faqs.q: What is your manufacturing and quality process?
faqs.a: We follow a structured six-step process covering sourcing, cleaning and sorting, controlled drying, grinding and sieving, quality inspection, and packaging and dispatch.

faqs.q: Do you provide product samples before placing a bulk order?
faqs.a: Yes. Product samples are available on request to help commercial buyers evaluate mesh size, colour, pungency, and application performance.

faqs.q: What export and compliance support do you offer?
faqs.a: We are an FSSAI-licensed manufacturer and IEC-registered exporter in India. We assist buyers with export documentation support, invoices, packing lists, and certificates of origin.
